tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find AI tools on Lufi with their independent trust scores. Filter by free text (name or task), intent (productivity, creative, analytical, agentic), compliance label (e.g. SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR), the AI company a tool runs on (e.g. Anthropic), official MCP server, or free plan.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get one AI tool's Lufi trust score, human and agent sub-scores, review counts, compliance labels with sources, data and rights answers, watch-outs, models, which AI companies it runs on, connectors, Zapier/Make listings and MCP server, pricing, and recent market news.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare two to five AI tools side by side on Lufi trust scores, compliance, model providers, MCP and pricing.
